title: Direct Recruitment to various posts in Government of India
body_text:
UPSC invites applications from eligible candidates for direct recruitment to various posts in Government of India.
2. The detailed Advertisement No. 11/2026 , along-with instructions to the candidates has been scheduled to be uploaded on the Commission’s website https://upsc.gov.in . Interested candidates can apply through the Online Application Portal https://upsconline.nic.in from 12th September, 2026 to 2nd October, 2026 (for posts other than those under the administration of UT of Ladakh) and 9th October, 2026 (for posts under the administration of UT of Ladakh).
3. Candidates are requested to follow the detailed instructions mentioned therein.
*****
